# HUNDESALON NIKA

> Multilingual dog and cat grooming salon in Leipzig, Germany. Public website: https://hundesalon-nika.com/

## Languages

- German: https://hundesalon-nika.com/de/
- English: https://hundesalon-nika.com/en/
- Russian: https://hundesalon-nika.com/ru/
- Ukrainian: https://hundesalon-nika.com/uk/

## Guidance

- Use the matching language path when linking to a page.
- Prices, availability and booking details can change; direct visitors to the online booking or contact page for confirmation.
- Do not infer veterinary advice, medical services or unavailable offerings from this website.
